task.description:
Produce a test spec at tests/specs/DSL-01.md for DSL-01 (Grammar conformance).

The spec must cover the two acceptance criteria from the requirement:
1. For each grammar production, at least one positive and one negative parser test exists.
2. Rejection messages include the line number, column number, and the offending token.

Grammar productions to cover (from Architecture §5.1 / docs/addon-1/01-architecture.md):
  or_expr, and_expr, not_expr, cmp_expr, add_expr, mul_expr, unary, primary (number/string/bool/null/identifier/dot-path/grouped), func_call

For each production include:
- TC-DSL01-NNN id
- Input expression string
- Expected outcome: PASS (parsed successfully) or FAIL (ParseError with expected line, column, token)
- Which acceptance criterion it satisfies

Also include integration-level test cases:
- A compound expression using multiple operators (gateway condition example: order.total > 10000 and customer.tier == "VIP")
- A call to each of the 11 whitelisted built-in functions (length, lower, upper, trim, contains, startsWith, endsWith, coalesce, now, date_add, date_diff)
- An expression with a non-whitelisted function name — must be rejected
- A deeply nested dot-path (a.b.c.d) — must parse successfully

Output: tests/specs/DSL-01.md
acceptance_criteria: At least one positive and one negative test case per grammar production (9 productions × 2 = 18 minimum)
All 11 whitelisted built-in functions covered with positive tests
Non-whitelisted function name covered with a negative test
Each negative test specifies expected line, column, and offending token

result.summary: Produced tests/specs/DSL-01.md: 56 test cases covering all 9 grammar productions (28 positive + 14 negative for productions, 11 built-in function coverage cases, 3 non-whitelisted rejection cases, 14 integration/precedence/error-format cases). Every negative test specifies expected line, column, and offending token derived from the lexer and parser source.
